These small fixtures are excerpts from public HMT responses saved on 2 November
2026. Catalogue pages retain the first 2, 3, and 4 cards from the real cumulative
windows (27, 54, 74), with the original load-more signals. URLs intentionally
contain changing encrypted identifiers; numeric onclick IDs remain stable.

`detail-out.html` retains the main product section and specification lists of

The positive purchase-control test is explicitly synthetic: no in-stock product
was exposed during inspection. Its compatibility with a live purchasable product
must be checked when HMT next has stock.
